assertions: The response routes to the chemprop training-cli sub-skill rather than any other route.
The response emits a chemprop train command with --task-type classification, --smiles-columns smiles, and --target-columns tox_a tox_b tox_c.
The response includes --metrics roc prc accuracy f1 and --tracking-metric prc, matching the training-cli SKILL.md explicit classification example.
The response includes --class-balance and explains it is valid only for --task-type classification.
The response uses CPU-safe smoke flags (--accelerator cpu, --epochs 3, --num-workers 0) and an explicit --output-dir.
The response states the checkpoint output layout as <output-dir>/model_0/best.pt and config.toml as documented in training-cli SKILL.md.
The response does not tell the user to open the original Chemprop source repository.
